title: Human-level control through deep reinforcement learning
authors: Volodymyr Mnih;Koray Kavukcuoglu;David Silver;Andrei A. Rusu;Joel Veness;Marc G. Bellemare;Alex Graves;et al.
abstract: We propose a deep Q-network that combines reinforcement learning with deep neural networks and demonstrate human-level performance on Atari 2600 games.

title: Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search
authors: David Silver;Aja Huang;Chris J. Maddison;Arthur Guez;Laurent Sifre;George van den Driessche;Julian Schrittwieser;et al.
abstract: We introduce a new approach to computer Go using value networks and policy networks combined with Monte Carlo tree search.

title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
authors: John Schulman;Filip Wolski;Prafulla Dhariwal;Alec Radford;Oleg Klimov
abstract: We propose a new family of policy gradient methods for reinforcement learning which alternate between sampling data and optimizing a surrogate objective.

title: Learning Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
authors: OpenAI;Marcin Andrychowicz;Bowen Baker;Maciek Chociej;Rafal Jozefowicz;Bob McGrew;Jakub Pachocki;Arthur Petron;et al.
abstract: We use reinforcement learning to learn dexterous in-hand manipulation policies which can be deployed on a physical robot.

title: Generative Adversarial Imitation Learning
abstract: We propose a new general framework for directly extracting a policy from data as if it were obtained by reinforcement learning following the expert.

title: Grandmaster level in StarCraft II using multi-agent reinforcement learning
authors: Oriol Vinyals;Igor Babuschkin;Wojciech M. Czarnecki;Michaël Mathieu;Andrew Dudzik;Junyoung Chung;David H. Choi;et al.
abstract: We introduce StarCraft II as a benchmark for multi-agent reinforcement learning and present AlphaStar which grandmaster-level.

title: Conservative Q-Learning for Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: We propose Conservative Q-Learning a simple offline RL algorithm that learns a conservative Q-function to avoid overestimation on out-of-distribution actions.
